hjalp.agent-gjort.fraga: Where do I see what the agent has done?
hjalp.agent-gjort.svar:
**Home** shows the agent's latest moves. What it found in an app is in that app's session in **Foundation**; a number or a dot means something you haven't read. The rest is in **the Agent**.

**Tasks** in the bar on the left shows each task with its status, when it last ran, when it runs next and what's new. Click one to open it, and **Status and options** for the finds, what was set aside, **Run now**, **Change how often**, **Pause** and **Delete**.
hjalp.agent-gora.fraga: What may the agent do in my apps?
hjalp.agent-gora.svar:
Create a reminder, add a meeting, put an email draft in Drafts, write a note in the folder you chose, run a shortcut you've built — and suggest replies to emails waiting for you.

By default it asks every time: the suggestion appears in the conversation with **Yes, do it** and **No**. Under **Settings → Agent → Actions** you choose per action: *Ask every time*, *Allowed* or *Never*. With *Allowed* it does it right away when you ask for it yourself at the computer; when it works on its own, it's still a suggestion. Reminders and meetings can be **undone**.

A suggested reply is never sent by the agent. It goes out only when you press **Send**, and for ten seconds you can undo. Messages are never sent, and it never changes or deletes anything you wrote yourself.
hjalp.agent-stangd.fraga: Does the agent run when the app is closed?
hjalp.agent-stangd.svar:
By default it runs while Maximus is open, and catches up on what it missed when the computer wakes.

Under **Settings → Agent → Work** → *When the agent runs* you can have **Maximus open when the computer starts** (with the window hidden if you like) or let the agent run **in the background, even when the app is closed**.

On battery it looks less often. With a password it runs only once Maximus is unlocked, or if the password is saved in the keychain.
hjalp.agent-uppdrag.fraga: How do I give the agent a task?
hjalp.agent-uppdrag.svar:
Say it like you would to a colleague: *"keep an eye on AI news in my inbox and pick out what concerns my role"*.

Maximus shows the task before anything happens and asks **when**: at a set time (*"weekdays 08:00"*), when something happens (*"tell me when Henrik emails"*, *"as soon as something lands in Downloads"*), every hour, or **just once, now**.

A topic needs no address: *"keep an eye on AI in the public sector"* — the agent finds the sources itself and shows them. A search can be handed over: end with *"… in the background"*, and you get a notification when it's done.
hjalp.agent-vad.svar:
It works when you're not looking. It reads what you've allowed — the inbox, calendar, reminders, notes, messages, a folder, the web — and tells you when something concerns you.

What it finds in an app ends up in that app's own session in **Foundation**. Everything else ends up in **the Agent**, a running conversation where yesterday and older are collapsed. Talk to it there: *"what happened last night?"*, *"run the inbox now"*, *"pause everything until Monday"*.

It works one step at a time — reads an email, looks for free slots, calculates, searches the web — and you see the steps. What it filters out it sets aside, with a reason.
hjalp.allt-meny.fraga: Where can I see everything Maximus can do?
hjalp.allt-meny.svar:
Under **…** in the bar on the left → **Everything Maximus can do**. The assistant and the agent are shown in two columns, with a search box at the top.

Click a row to try it. The agent's rows write the task in the box for you, and you send it yourself. The assistant's rows show what to do.

Each row has **How?**, which opens help on that exact thing.
hjalp.arkiv.svar:
The agent moves finished conversations to **Archive**: investigations and one-time searches after a week, your own conversations untouched for 30 days. Never pinned, locked or ones in a project. What you bring back it doesn't touch again. Turn it off under **Settings → Agent → Work**.

Under **Settings → Your data** you can let Maximus delete conversations after a time you choose, or **Clear everything** and start over. Sent stays.
hjalp.datum.fraga: What happens when an answer has a date?
hjalp.datum.svar:
If it says something will happen on a certain date — a meeting, a delivery — Maximus puts a **plan** under the answer: what happens, how far away it is, what needs to be ready and what it needs to know.

Pick one or more: **Prepare me**, **Gather in a project**, **Remind me** or **Add to calendar**. **Add to calendar** opens a calendar file; you add it to Calendar yourself.
hjalp.dela.fraga: How do I share a conversation?
hjalp.dela.svar:
Press **share** in the conversation's top bar. Maximus makes an encrypted file and a code, and **Share…** opens the Mac's share menu: Mail, Messages, AirDrop.

Send the file and the code **in different ways** — if both are in the same email, the encryption is just decoration.

The recipient drags the file into their Maximus and types the code.
hjalp.diktering.fraga: Can I speak instead of typing?
hjalp.diktering.svar:
Yes. Press the **microphone** by the input field. What you say is written in the box while you talk, on the computer. Say **"send"** to send, or **"cancel"** (or Esc) to remove what you said. Press the microphone again to stop and keep the text.

By default it sends after three seconds of silence. Change that under **Settings → You → Appearance and input**.
hjalp.djupsokning.svar:
The magnifying glass by the input field. Instead of one search, Maximus does several: searches, reads, sees what's still missing and searches again for exactly that.

Press it before the question; it applies to that question. If Web search is set to *Off*, nothing is searched.

Good for big questions with several parts. By default the search takes up to about three minutes. How thorough is set under **Settings → You → Answers**.
hjalp.du-linkedin.fraga: How does Maximus learn who I am?
hjalp.du-linkedin.svar:
Under **Settings → You → Profile**. Write it yourself, import your **LinkedIn export** or a **CV**, or let Maximus read **your profile page in Safari**. It becomes a suggestion that you read and save.

If you said yes to ongoing following when you started, the agent also reads your LinkedIn feed in Safari. A month after an import, Maximus reminds you to make a new export. It **never posts, likes or contacts anyone** in your name.
hjalp.epost-kalender.fraga: Can MAXIMUS read my email and calendar?
hjalp.epost-kalender.svar:
Yes, from Apple Mail and Calendar, once you've given permission under **Settings → Agent → Sources**. **/mail** shows the ten latest headlines in the inbox, **/calendar** the meetings in the next seven days. What you open becomes a conversation. You can also just ask: *"what meetings do I have tomorrow?"*

Maximus never sends anything unless you press Send, and never deletes or moves anything.
hjalp.export.fraga: Can I get an answer as Word, PDF or PowerPoint?
hjalp.export.svar:
Yes. Press **Make a file of the answer** under the answer and choose **Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel or Markdown**. Excel requires the answer to have a table. The file lands in Downloads and is saved in the conversation.

The whole conversation as a PDF: **…** on the conversation's row in the list → **Decision brief as PDF**.
hjalp.filer.svar:
Drag in a PDF, a Word document, a spreadsheet, a text file, an image, or an audio or video file. Everything is read on the computer.

The file becomes a **card** in the conversation with **Original** and **Masked**. Press **Anonymize** on the card for a third version. If the conversation is set to Original, the file isn't masked. If the conversation is empty, Maximus summarizes the file right away.

In spreadsheets Maximus calculates sum, average and median itself, so the numbers add up.
hjalp.fragar-fore.fraga: Why does MAXIMUS sometimes ask before searching?
hjalp.fragar-fore.svar:
Some questions are sensitive even when no name is in them — a question about an illness, a threat or a protected identity. Then Maximus shows exactly which words the search would send, and waits for your yes.

It applies to the whole conversation: if it has been about something sensitive earlier, it applies to the follow-up questions too.
hjalp.frister.fraga: Can MAXIMUS remind me of deadlines?
hjalp.frister.svar:
Yes, in two ways.

If an answer contains a date you can choose **Remind me** in the plan under the answer.

If a deadline is set in a **law** — "within three weeks of the day you received the decision" — Maximus offers to track it. You enter the start date yourself, because only you know it.

Deadlines are listed under **/watch**, and the one coming up is shown when you open the app.
hjalp.gor-inte.svar:
- Doesn't protect against malware already on your computer.
- Doesn't decide for you what's sensitive. It shows, you decide.
- Doesn't replace legal or medical judgment. The model can be wrong.
- Does nothing in your apps without your yes, unless you've chosen *Allowed* for a kind of action. It never deletes or changes what you wrote yourself.
- Never sends anything unless you press Send. Messages are never sent, and it never posts, likes or contacts anyone on LinkedIn.
hjalp.grunden.svar:
The sessions at the top of the list: **You**, one per app you've given the agent (**Inbox**, **Calendar**, **Reminders**, **Notes**, **Messages**) and **News** if you've turned it on. That's where the agent writes what it finds in the app, and in You, Maximus keeps its picture of you.

A number means new finds. A dot means something has been written since you were last there. The sessions can't be deleted one by one, only with **Clear everything** under **Settings → Your data**.
hjalp.hem.svar:
**News for you** and **the agent's latest moves**: what it has found, looked into or got stuck on, newest first.

Click a news item and it becomes a new conversation, with the article as material and a question ready in the box. Click a move to open it.
hjalp.installningar.svar:
The gear in the bar on the left, or **…** → **Settings**. Seven tabs; the selected tab's sections are listed in the panel on the left.

**You**: profile, answers (the voice, your rules, templates, deep search) and appearance and input. **Agent**: sources, work, actions and how it notifies you. **Protection**: lock, what is hidden and the web. **Model**: on this computer, in the cloud, and image and audio. **Connections**: open sources like lagen.nu and SCB, more to connect, and the browser extension. **Your data**: Sent, retention and Clear everything. **About Maximus**: new versions, the license and the terms.
hjalp.kommandon.fraga: Which commands and shortcuts are there?
hjalp.kommandon.svar:
Type a **slash** in the field and the commands unfold, with a line on what each one does:

/help · /me (what I know about you) · /mail (your email) · /calendar · /watch · /tasks · /agent · /finds · /record · /presentation · /document · /deepdive · /tour · /clear · /settings

**⌘N** new conversation · **⌘⇧R** record a meeting · **⌘+ ⌘− ⌘0** larger, smaller, normal size · **Esc** closes whatever is open, otherwise goes to Home · **Esc twice** goes to Rest.

**Back and forward** like in a browser: **⌘[** and **⌘]**, swipe with two fingers on the trackpad, or the mouse side buttons.

Select text in an answer to quote it. Hover over your own question to copy it, get a masked version, or edit and run it again.
hjalp.kopplingar.svar:
Sources Maximus reads directly instead of searching the web: **lagen.nu**, **Domstolsverket**, **Riksdagen**, **SCB**, **Kolada** and **IVO**. If you ask what a law says, the answer is the law text.

Under **Settings → Connections** you can also connect a folder, Notion or a remote connection to another service. Every lookup is listed under Sent.
hjalp.kostar.svar: **Nothing.** Maximus is free and **open source under Apache-2.0**. You can read, change and share the code.
hjalp.lagbevakning.svar:
Maximus follows the laws your answers were based on. If the law text changes, or new rulings refer to the section, it shows up on Home and under **/watch**. It happens on its own.

Only the law's number and the section go to lagen.nu, never your question or your case. Every check is listed under Sent.
hjalp.mallar.fraga: Can the answers have my own look?
hjalp.mallar.svar:
Yes, for **/presentation** and **/document**. Add your presentation template (**.potx** or .pptx) and document template (**.dotx** or .docx) under **Settings → You → Answers → Templates**.

Presentations get the template's fonts, colors, slide format, background and logo. Documents get the template's styles. **Make a file of the answer** doesn't use the template.
hjalp.maskering.svar:
The model on your computer always reads your real text.

Masking applies to what goes **somewhere else**: a search, the cloud model or a text you paste into ChatGPT. Then names, personal ID numbers, addresses and phone numbers are replaced with labels like [PERSON A] and [PERSONAL ID A]. The same detail gets the same label throughout the conversation.

Hover over your question and press the mask icon to see and copy the masked version. What is hidden is chosen under **Settings → Protection → What is hidden**.

If you want a text masked or anonymized, ask for it in the conversation: **Mask this text: …**, **Anonymize the attachment** or **Mask your last answer**. It is done on the computer, and you get the text, the number of replaced details and the map.
hjalp.minne.fraga: What do the memory options mean?
hjalp.minne.svar:
**Isolated**: the conversation only knows what you write in it, and the other conversations in the project if it's in one.

**Remember me**: Maximus brings in what fits the question from your earlier conversations and shows which ones. Locked conversations and conversations set to be forgotten are never read.

**Forget after**: the conversation is deleted when you leave it.

A new conversation starts as Isolated. What you've told it about yourself under **Settings → You → Profile** always applies.
hjalp.modell.svar:
Maximus picks a model based on how much memory the computer has and downloads it on first launch. Audio is transcribed by a separate, smaller model. Both run on your computer.

Switch under **Settings → Model → On this computer**, and the audio model under **Image and audio**. If you'd rather use a cloud model: see "Can I use ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini instead?".
hjalp.molnet.fraga: Can I use ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini instead?
hjalp.molnet.svar:
Yes, under **Settings → Model → In the cloud**.

**OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and Berget AI** (Sweden): you add a key. **OpenRouter**: you sign in with your account and reach ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini in one place. It's experimental and not properly tested yet.

Everything that goes out is **masked first**. **Strict** (default): names, numbers, addresses, places and workplaces are hidden. **Personal data**: companies and places remain. Below the level you see exactly what would go out. Images are never sent.

The answer is restored on the computer. The key is kept in the macOS keychain, and every call is listed under **Sent**.
hjalp.mote.svar:
Yes. Press **⌘⇧R** or type **/record**. (The microphone by the input field is for dictation, see "Can I speak instead of typing?".)

A line shows the time and that the microphone hears something. If it hasn't heard anything for ten seconds, it says **The microphone hears nothing**.

Press **Stop and transcribe** when the meeting is over. The recording is transcribed on the computer and becomes a document in the conversation with a time on every line. Maximus summarizes it: what it was about, what was decided, who does what and when, and what is still open.

**The audio is never saved**, only the text.
hjalp.natet.fraga: When does MAXIMUS search the web?
hjalp.natet.svar:
It depends on the **Web search** option by the send arrow, or under **Settings → Protection → Web**: *Off*, *Auto* or *On*.

On *Auto*, Maximus only searches when the question needs something the model can't know: today's rules, a price, a particular company, something happening now. Personal questions and questions about your own work or your documents aren't searched. On *On*, every question is searched.

If the question is sensitive, Maximus shows exactly what would be sent and asks you first. If you write that something shouldn't be looked up, it isn't searched. Names and numbers are removed from the search, and the sources are shown under the answer with numbers.
hjalp.navigera.svar:
Like in a browser. **⌘[** goes back and **⌘]** forward. On the trackpad you swipe with two fingers, and the mouse side buttons work too.

Back goes all the way to **Home**, the house in the bar on the left. **Esc** closes whatever is open; if nothing is open, you go to Home.
hjalp.nyheter.svar:
From **What interests you** under **Settings → You → Profile**. If that field is empty, **What you work on** is used.

The agent finds sources and reads them every three hours. If you've given the agent the inbox, it also reads newsletters on the topics. Each item is weighed against who you are; the weightiest and newest come first. Product pages, guides and ads are set aside.

Turn it on or off under **Settings → Agent → Sources**.
hjalp.rapportera.fraga: Something is not working. How do I tell you?
hjalp.rapportera.svar:
Choose **Report a problem** in the menu at the top right, or type something like "this doesn't work" or "report a bug" in the box. Maximus asks what you were trying to do and what happened instead, and writes a short draft in your own words.

Before anything happens you see the whole text and can change it. App version, macOS version and chip are suggested, and you choose whether to include them. No conversation, document, audio, screenshot or file path is included. Names, numbers, addresses and keys are hidden in the text, but that is a safeguard and not a guarantee, so read it through.

The report is sent as an ordinary email from your own address to Aurolabs. With **Send by email** Maximus opens the email in Mail with exactly the text you approved, and you press Send yourself. You can also copy the report or save it as a file.
hjalp.rosten.fraga: Can I change how MAXIMUS sounds?
hjalp.rosten.svar:
Yes, under **Settings → You → Answers → The voice**.

**Professional** — factual and short. **Clear** — explains without assuming prior knowledge. **Cocky** — direct and confident, but drops the style when something is heavy.

The voice only changes the tone. What is protected and what may be claimed stays the same. A change applies to new conversations.
hjalp.skicka-pilen.fraga: What do the options by the send arrow mean?
hjalp.skicka-pilen.svar:
Three options. What you choose in the first two applies to the conversation and becomes the default for new conversations. Memory applies only to the conversation; a new one starts as Isolated.

**What you get to take with you.** *Original*: the text as it is. *Masked*: names and numbers are replaced with [PERSON A] and the like, so you can paste the text somewhere else. *Anonymized*: masked, and also rewritten so details reveal less.

**Web search.** *Off*: never. *Auto*: only when the question needs something the model can't know. *On*: every time.

**Memory.** *Isolated*, *Remember me* or *Forget after*. See "What do the memory options mean?".

The model on your computer always reads the original. What goes out on the web or to the cloud model is always masked, whatever you've chosen.
hjalp.skickat.svar:
Everything that has left the computer: when, where and exactly what. A search, a fetched page, a call to the cloud model, a check for a new version, a notification to your phone — one line each time.

The list can be exported as CSV, JSON or text. There's no button that empties it, and **Clear everything** doesn't touch it. In Sent you can turn off the logging and prune old rows.
hjalp.skriva.fraga: Can Maximus write and rewrite for me?
hjalp.skriva.svar:
Yes. Ask for a **draft**, or paste a text and ask Maximus to **reframe** it, make it **vaguer** or **summarize** long material. Two versions of the same text can be **compared**: Maximus shows what changed and what it means.

If you ask a question with several parts it's split up: you see the plan first and then get one answer per part.
hjalp.skydda.fraga: How do I protect my conversations?
hjalp.skydda.svar:
**A password for Maximus** (Settings → Protection → Lock) locks your conversations and settings on disk. Without it, anyone with access to the computer can read them.

**Lock when you step away** is a six-digit code that closes Maximus, automatically after a while if you like. It requires that you've set a password.

**A single conversation** is locked with a code in the row menu. *Locked*: if you forget the code, the password opens it. *Sealed*: if you forget the code, it's gone for good.
hjalp.telefon.fraga: Can Maximus notify me on my phone?
hjalp.telefon.svar:
Yes. Under **Settings → Agent → Notifications → To your phone** choose **Reminder via iCloud** or **iMessage**. **Send a test** shows what it looks like.

Maximus only sends when something important has happened and the computer has been untouched for ten minutes: the headline and one line, at most four times an hour and twelve a day. **Notify when the agent finds something** must be on.

With Reminders you can reply: **check it off** when you've seen it, **write in the note** and it ends up in the conversation, or add your own reminder to the Maximus list. You read the answer at the computer.
hjalp.tempo.fraga: Why does the fan sometimes run?
hjalp.tempo.svar:
The agent only uses the model when something new has come in. Between runs it makes no model calls.

**Pace** under **Settings → Agent → Work** controls how often it looks and how much it investigates on its own. **Calm**: every fifteen minutes, at most one investigation an hour. **Normal**: every five minutes, at most three an hour. **Full throttle**: every minute, up to twelve an hour. Only Full throttle investigates on battery.

hjalp.uppdragsvyn.fraga: What do the rows under Tasks mean?
hjalp.uppdragsvyn.svar:
Each row is a task, with **Status**, **Last**, **Next** and **New**.

**waiting**: hasn't run yet. **running**: runs on its schedule. **reading now**: running right now. **done**: a one-time task that's finished. **paused**: by you, maybe until a date, or after three failures in a row. **New** shows how many new finds it has.

Click a task to open it. Under **Status and options** you run it now, change how often, pause or delete it. The box at the bottom is only for new tasks.
hjalp.vad-ar.svar:
An AI assistant that runs **on your own computer**. What you write, the files you drag in and the answers you get stay there.

You can ask about anything, drag in documents and recordings, and let **the agent** keep an eye on your inbox, calendar, reminders, notes, messages and your LinkedIn feed. Each app you've given permission to gets its own session in **Foundation**, and **Home** shows news for you and what the agent has done.

What can leave the computer: web searches (Web search is set to Auto from the start), the cloud model if you've turned it on, pages and news the agent fetches, and connections like lagen.nu. Search queries and what goes to the cloud model are masked first. All of it is listed under **Sent**. A notification to your phone is just a headline and one line, with names masked, and is also listed under Sent.
hjalp.vila.svar:
After a while without you touching anything, Maximus dims and the mark sits in the middle, like a screensaver. With a password Maximus is also locked. Click the mark in the corner to rest right away.

How long, and whether Maximus should open in rest mode, is set under **Settings → Protection → Lock**.
